Name: Drone Remote Control 0.2.22 - Private Prototype
Description: 0.2.22 - Fixes Q+Quick Throw arming being reset by an absent/unsupported Guard Dog backpack. Waits up to 3s for the actor's attached Seeker and accepts observed free-flight states 3 and 4 with native motion active. No synthetic throw or adoption of nearby flying drones. On detonation, immediately releases AI/movement overrides and hides meshes only on the exact exploded unit; native damage/effects/destruction remain unchanged. Keeps only the last camera pose for 0.7s, then restores player view/input. Solo only; five Guard Dog families and equipped Q+Attack retained. Requires Bingus Shared Loader API 1. Fully exit, replace, deploy and restart. Fixes passed offline tests; in-game confirmation is pending.

Options.Name: Backpack and Seeker Control - Solo Private Test
Options.Description: Backpack: hold Aim Mode Switch and press Backpack Function, then release both; Backpack exits. Range 100m; overheating or empty ammo exits. Seeker: hold Aim Mode Switch and use mapped Quick Throw; alternatively equip slot 4 and use Q+Attack. Release the throw/attack key for native deployment. Fresh Attack or Aim Mode Switch requests detonation, followed by a 0.7s frozen camera view. No range limit; lifetime 30s. Mapped movement, Dodge and Crouch are used. Both modes exit on a party join. In-game Auto Aim applies only to backpack drones. Apply and restart. Log: DroneRemoteControl.log.
